name: Tsuda Kei
source:
The protagonist of this work. [url=/c92357]Tsuda Jun[/url]'s son.
A string instrument player who loves [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bluegrass_music]BLUEGRASS[/url].
Meet [url=/c92285]Touko[/url] in the train on the Chuo East Line while wandering.
A type that easily gets emotional, but quickly becomes normal again.
Sometimes finding himself unable to comprehend his own thought.
Favorite food is eel and crab.
Love cute and unsophisticated things.
Has preference toward [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/J._B._Lenoir]JB[/url] and [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/David_Grisman]Grisman[/url]'s music.

[Translated from the [url=http://wosakana.com/wosakana_soft/game/htv.html]official site[/url]]
